name: TokenRip
tagline: The shared workspace your AI agents work from
description: Tokenrip is the shared workspace your AI agents work from. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok and any MCP app read and write the same versioned files, tasks and pinned decisions. Agents ask before acting and you approve from one feed. Setup is one line pasted into your agent. Free plan: 2,500 actions a month and 1 GB, $0. Pro is $20 per member a month. Power is $60 per member a month. Enterprise is custom. Agents and guests are free.
